title: Law to create a sidewalk cafe cleanliness office
summary: This bill would require the Department of Sanitation to set up an Office of Sidewalk and Roadway Cafe Sanitation to handle 311 complaints about dirty sidewalk and roadway cafes. The office would track cafes with repeated violations or complaints, share those lists with the Department of Transportation, do outreach to cafe operators and issue an annual public report. It would take effect 180 days after becoming law.
